default_account.description: Name of the default account to use if no --account flag is provided.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to 'off' to disable logging (not recommended for production).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'mail', 'daemon'). Leave blank to use file logging only.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS globally. If enabled, TLS is used for all accounts unless overridden per-account.

tls_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS (for port 587 or 25) or implicit TLS (for port 465). Set false only for insecure test environments.

tls_trust_file.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle file (PEM format) to verify the server certificate.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate (PEM) for mutual TLS (optional).

tls_key_file.description: Path to client private key (PEM) for mutual TLS (optional, must match cert).

tls_nocertcheck.description: Skip server certificate verification (dangerous — only for internal testing).

tls_min_dhparam.description: Minimum DH key size (e.g., '2048') — use to enforce stronger key exchange (optional).

tls_priorities.description: GnuTLS priority string (e.g., 'NORMAL:%SERVER_PREF_CIPHER') for fine-grained TLS control (optional).

ca_bundle_file.description: Legacy alias for tls_trust_file. Prefer tls_trust_file instead.

accounts.description: List of SMTP accounts (profiles). At least one account is required for real-world usage.

host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address (e.g., 'smtp.gmail.com').

from_addr.description: Return address (envelope sender) used in emails sent via this account.

auth_method.description: Authentication method. Leave blank for unauthenticated relay (not recommended for public servers).

user.description: SMTP username for authentication (if auth_method is set).

password.description: SMTP password for authentication (store securely — consider using a credentials helper).

tls.description: Override global TLS setting for this account (true/false). If omitted, uses global setting.

tls_starttls.description: STARTTLS for this account (ignored if tls=false).

tls_trust_file.description: Per-account CA cert file (overrides global tls_trust_file).

tls_nocertcheck.description: Disable cert verification for this account only (dangerous — avoid in production).

catch_all_host.description: Legacy: SMTP server hostname for a single catch-all fallback account (deprecated in favor of 'accounts').

catch_all_from.description: Legacy: Sender address for catch-all fallback (used with catch_all_host).

catch_all_tls.description: Use TLS for legacy catch-all account.

catch_all_tls_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS for legacy catch-all account (if catch_all_tls=true).
